_comment: Simple explainer video using narration shorthand. Each video clip has inline narration that auto-generates a TTS clip and fit_to reference.

project.name: How Photosynthesis Works
project.description: A short explainer about photosynthesis for a science channel

tts._comment: Kore is a clear, neutral voice good for educational content

narration.text: Photosynthesis is the process by which plants convert sunlight into energy. It happens in the chloroplasts, tiny organelles inside plant cells.

source.prompt: Cinematic macro shot of green leaves in sunlight, light rays filtering through, photosynthesis visualization, nature documentary style

generate.prompt: Macro photograph of vibrant green leaves with sunlight streaming through, showing detailed leaf veins, nature documentary still

narration.text: The plant absorbs carbon dioxide from the air and water from the soil. Using sunlight as fuel, it transforms these into glucose and oxygen.

source.prompt: Animated diagram of a plant cell chloroplast, CO2 and water molecules entering, glucose forming, educational motion graphics style

generate.prompt: Clean educational diagram of a plant cell chloroplast cross-section with labeled CO2 and H2O molecules, flat design motion graphics style

narration.text: This process is essential for life on Earth. It produces the oxygen we breathe and forms the base of nearly every food chain.

source.prompt: Wide aerial shot of a lush green forest canopy, oxygen molecules rising into blue sky, cinematic nature documentary

generate.prompt: Aerial photograph of dense green forest canopy stretching to the horizon under clear blue sky, nature documentary still
